$comment: The same vehicle released in hover at 1.32 m with a 0.8 rad/s yaw kick and a 0.3 rad/s roll kick, then a 1 m lateral step from 3 s, 8 s: the control and passive-yaw test. Generated by design/build_model.py.

parameters.name: cyclic_gain
parameters.description: Plant: mean hub moment per N m of cyclic torque (the allocation assumes 0.25)

parameters.description: Cyclic torque amplitude limit of the allocation

parameters.name: tilt_limit
parameters.description: Thrust-vector tilt limit of the position controller

options.text: One motor makes the thrust **and** the roll/pitch moments: the motor torque is modulated once per revolution, the rotor speeds up and slows down within each turn, and the lag-pitch hinges turn that into a cyclic blade pitch. **Yaw has no actuator**; the fins carry the motor reaction and damp the yaw rate. `cyclic_gain` is the plant's gain; the controller keeps assuming 0.25. Press **Run** after a change.
